mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation_order ( order_no, contact_name, contact_type, contact_value, topic_text, request_text, expected_time, price_cents, status ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{contactName}, #{contactType}, #{contactValue}, #{topicText}, #{requestText}, CAST(#{expectedTime} AS TIMESTAMPTZ), #{priceCents}, 'submitted' )
mapper.select: SELECT order_no, price_cents, free_quota_used, status, NULL AS wechat_id, TO_CHAR(confirmed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS confirmed_at FROM consultation_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

where.if: AND (order_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR contact_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR contact_value ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT order_no, contact_name, contact_value, topic_text, price_cents, status, TO_CHAR(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at FROM consultation_order
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT order_no, contact_name, contact_type, contact_value, topic_text, request_text, TO_CHAR(expected_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS expected_time, price_cents, free_quota_used, status, admin_note, TO_CHAR(confirmed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS confirmed_at, TO_CHAR(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at FROM consultation_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT status FROM consultation_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT used_count FROM consultation_quota WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE consultation_quota SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = 1 AND used_count < 10
UPDATE consultation_quota SET used_count = GREATEST(used_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = 1

UPDATE consultation_order SET status = 'confirmed', admin_note = #{adminNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, price_cents = #{priceCents}, free_quota_used = #{freeQuotaUsed}, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'submitted'
UPDATE consultation_order SET status = 'completed', admin_note = #{adminNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'confirmed'
UPDATE consultation_order SET status = 'canceled', admin_note = #{adminNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN ('submitted', 'confirmed')
